metadata.title: Chapter 2: Terrestrial and Freshwater Ecosystems and Their Services

blocks.text: Figure 2.1 | Overview of observed impacts of climate change on terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems, including species range shifts, phenology changes, and risks to ecosystem services that people depend on.
Figure 2.3 | Changes in freshwater ecosystems and river flow under warming, with implications for aquatic biodiversity, wetland integrity, and water-related ecosystem services.

Figure 2.x (adaptation summary) | Ecosystem-based adaptation and protection of climate refugia can increase resilience of biodiversity and ecosystem services; restoration and habitat connectivity reduce fragmentation risks but cannot substitute for greenhouse gas emission reductions.
